messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
By the time I caught the bus, I had an ankle the size of my waist and a throbbing pain to match it.

output.original_text: By the time I caught the bus, I had an ankle the size of my waist and a throbbing pain to match it.
output.joy: By the time I caught the bus, I had a huge ankle, but I felt so cheerful despite the throbbing pain!
output.sadness: By the time I caught the bus, my ankle was the size of my waist, and the throbbing pain only reminded me of how much I was struggling.
output.fear: By the time I caught the bus, my ankle was alarmingly swollen, and the throbbing pain had me worried about what could be wrong.
output.anger: By the time I finally caught the bus, my ankle was the size of my waist, and I was furious at how much pain I was in!
output.surprise: By the time I caught the bus, I was shocked to see my ankle had ballooned to the size of my waist with a terrible throbbing pain to go along with it!
output.disgust: By the time I caught the bus, my ankle looked grotesquely swollen, matching the unpleasant throbbing pain I was feeling.
